payload.leagueSummary: NET is the whole damn story right now, and the top of the board is being decided by two very different kinds of mess: guys who can bail out their own chaos with short game and putting, and guys who are just flat-out cooking tee to green. The gross side says the ball-strikers are still the cleanest dudes in the room, but the net table keeps rewarding whoever can survive the ugly stretches without detonating. This window also has a clear split between the cream at the top and a pack of players bleeding strokes in multiple spots, which is why the standings feel less like a leaderboard and more like a triage unit.
leagueBullets: CRANK keeps winning net with a short-game-and-putting rescue act, even though the tee game is basically a write-off.
KeithK75 and Dan94 are the gross monsters: both are hammering tee to green, but KeithK75 is converting that into the best gross run while Dan94 is pure boom-stick with fewer net wins to show for it.

The bottom end is ugly in a very specific way: several players are giving away strokes across multiple categories, and DREADFUL is especially committed to the bit with the worst putting and a total profile that keeps turning into a bonfire.
